name: snippets-seeded
description: Snippet routes over a seeded catalog whose file order is not canonical, and over seeded chats whose project folder lies outside the allowed base, is blank, or belongs to an executor that is not connected: load order, expansion from a registered chat that resolves the project path only for a template with an active project_path token, update and remove successes for a known identifier, revision, name and preamble-name conflicts, and a name freed by a remove.
